column1: # espice machine calibration (price plan sec. 4): one value per row, tab-separated.
# model: image Wyhash, then dev_us, host_p_us and host_e_us at 1, 64, 1024 and 16384
# Fixture for price.zig (`place`, lever p1) against gpu/placement.tsv: the machine
# placement.tsv was measured on (RTX 4060 Laptop sm_89, driver 595.71.05,
# i9-14900HX, P 0-15, E 16-31), written by hand for 08-placement.md step 3 before any
# `espice calibrate` ran. No row below was measured as a row: each is built from the
# numbers the tree records, named per row. Step 1's first measured file replaces it.
# The machine constants: gpu/placement.machine.tsv's, provenance there.
# Model rows. The image key is the model's name in ASCII, big-endian (price.zig's
# test maps placement.tsv's rows to these names by the decks' cards). host_e_us is
# not recorded for this machine: copied from host_p_us. jit_ms 0: SASS or a warm cache.
# History lines (ltra, cpl, txl) have no row: they stay on the host (sec. 7 q. 6).
# resistor: dev_us is eval_fixed_us plus gpu-phases.tsv's arp_evalc_resistor (1.7 us
# at 1,408 instances, 7.2 at 13,760, so 7.9 at 16,384 on that line); host_p_us the
# placement.tsv probe: 0.1 at the print floor, 2,000 resistors 4 us
# vsource: dev_us is eval_fixed_us plus gpu-phases.tsv's arp_eval_vsource (3.5 us at
# 64, 6.3 at 256; 1,024 taken as 256's, 16,384 extrapolated to 20 us, no deck
# measures it); host_p_us 0.1 at the print floor, past it resistor's rate (no
# vsource batch past 2 instances was probed).
# mos1: host_p_us from the probe rows: 4 instances 0.5 us (bench_tline_txl1_1_line),
# (parallel_inverters_2000, 0.069 each). dev_us is eval_fixed_us plus the stage-2
# price's device term, host us x slowdown 120 x ceil(count / 1000) / count; it gives
# 33 us at 4,000 where gpu-phases.tsv measures arp_eval_mos1 at 29.0 us (pinv2000).
# lane_gain 1: ParEval measured 1x or slower on the mos1 decks (placement.machine.tsv).
# hisim2: dev_us 1,328 us per eval of one instance against 10 us on the host
# (dc/device_hisim2, placement.machine.tsv's slowdown note); one wave to 64, then
# 40 + waves x 1,288 us (2 waves at 1,024, 17 at 16,384). host_p_us 10 us an instance.
